blueprint.overview: Reference shows a single LEGO-style minifigure character in a white outfit holding 1 blue energy sword. Plan below breaks it into 5 major sub-assemblies you can build as a small brick-built display figure (not a true minifig), staying within 25–200 pieces total.

subassemblies.name: Boots + legs base
subassemblies.description: WHERE: Bottom of the image (both feet/legs). Build 2 legs (left and right) and 2 blocky boots. Use 2 boots (each boot = 3 pieces) and 2 legs (each leg = 5 pieces) for a simple chunky stance.

subassemblies.name: Torso + belt/robe block
subassemblies.description: WHERE: Middle of the image (white torso with brown belt). Build 1 torso block, 1 belt band, and 1 lower robe/hip section. Suggested elements to include: 1 torso core, 1 front chest plate, 1 back plate, 1 belt stripe, and 1 hip/robe lip (so: 5 distinct elements).

subassemblies.name: Arms + hands (sword grip pose)
subassemblies.description: WHERE: Upper-middle, in front of torso holding the sword. Build 2 arms (left and right) and 2 hands. Pose should be a two-handed grip: 2 upper arms, 2 forearms, 2 hands (6 elements total).
subassemblies.imageRegion: upper-middle, slightly right of center (in front of torso)

subassemblies.name: Head + hair
subassemblies.description: WHERE: Top-left/upper area (face and blond hair). Build 1 head (with 1 face front) and 1 hair cap. Use 1 neck connector under the head (so: 3 elements total: 1 head, 1 hair, 1 neck).
subassemblies.imageRegion: top third, slightly left of center

subassemblies.name: Energy sword (hilt + blue blade)
subassemblies.description: WHERE: Right side of image, angled up. Build 1 sword consisting of 1 hilt and 1 blade. Hilt as a small cylinder stack: 3 elements (pommel, grip, emitter) plus 1 long blue blade element (total 4 elements).
subassemblies.imageRegion: right side, extending from hands to top-right corner
